2. (1) In these regulations, unless the context otherwise requires, "accredited
investor" means an investor who has been granted accreditation by the Authority
under regulation 19.

3. (1) These regulations shall apply to every Fund Management Entity registered
with the Authority in one of the following categories, namely Authorised,
Registered (Non-Retail) or Registered (Retail).

CHAPTER II
NET WORTH AND CAPITAL

8. (1) A Fund Management Entity registered as Registered (Non-Retail) shall at
all times maintain a net worth of not less than USD 500,000:

Provided that a Fund Management Entity which manages only Restricted Schemes
shall maintain a net worth of not less than USD 250,000.

Provided that a Fund Management Entity which manages only Restricted Schemes
shall maintain a net worth of not less than USD 250,000.

9. (1) A Fund Management Entity registered as Authorised shall at all times
maintain a net worth of not less than USD 75,000.

CHAPTER III
REPORTING

12. (1) Every Fund Management Entity shall file with the Authority a quarterly
return within 30 days of the end of each quarter.

13. (1) The quarterly return referred to in regulation 12 shall disclose the
total assets under management of the entity as at the last day of the quarter.

14. (1) A Fund Management Entity shall not accept a contribution from any single
investor of less than USD 150,000, except where that investor is an accredited
investor as defined in regulation 2.

15. (1) Where a Fund Management Entity fails to maintain the net worth specified
in regulation 8, it shall report that fact in the quarterly return.

16. (1) The Authority may, having regard to the interests of investors, specify
such additional disclosures as it considers appropriate.
